summary: Completed testing of cookie auth upgrade, social preview cards, and sitemap fix. Fixed critical CORS misconfiguration (allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True) that prevented cookie auth from working in browsers. All backend tests passing (15/15). Frontend cookie auth now working after CORS fix.

critical_bugs.issue: CORS_ORIGINS was set to '*' which is incompatible with allow_credentials=True in CORS middleware. Browsers block cookies when allow_origins='*' and allow_credentials=True are used together.

integration_issues.issue: After CORS fix, cookie auth works correctly. Users stay signed in across page reloads. Admin dashboard and account pages accessible. Minor: 2 console 401 errors still appear (likely from initial page load race condition before cookie is sent).
